facts.text: The CSU Tuition+ Promise uses grant funding to cover up to all base tuition for Colorado residents with qualifying income.

sources.title: CSU Tuition+ Promise - The Hub
sources.quote: Colorado State's Tuition+ Promise utilizes federal, state, and institutional grant funds to cover a portion, or up to all of a student's share of base tuition for students who have a qualified family Adjusted Gross Income (AGI)
